importUi.title: Import bookings without status
importUi.hint: Paste CSV/TSV with columns Booking Number, Suppliers, Station Code. Optional: Supplier Type (hotel, transportation, unclassified). Existing bookings and supplier details are preserved. No notes, statuses or invoice declarations are created. Multiple stations on a partial CW/period row are expanded into separate bookings; equivalent duplicate names keep the first spelling.

integrityHelp.title: What does Data integrity do?
integrityHelp.description: It compares the booking summary used by lists and reports with the latest valid note and the actual invoice records.
integrityHelp.scanHint: Read records and identify mismatches; scanning keeps the data unchanged.
integrityHelp.reviewHint: See the booking, field, current value and expected value before making a repair.
integrityHelp.repairHint: Recheck current records and rebuild the affected summary fields. Repairs are logged.
integrityHelp.example: Example: the latest note says Done while the list still shows Parking, or invoice_count differs from the stored invoice rows. Use this check after imports, administrative edits or an interrupted operation.
